checks.name: Unchanged resource polls do not repeat notifications
Actual load and construction remain observable
New attempt accepts reentrant queued cancellation
Reentrant cancellation restores caller without late completion
Cancelled loader can begin another attempt
Exact duplicates are suppressed but tiny progress and message changes survive
Terminal state does not emit repeated updates
Detached callers cannot acquire navigation ownership
Detaching a live caller cancels its threaded attempt

scope: Actual small threaded PackedScene parsing and reentrant cancellation, plus an explicitly synthetic sub-percent signal boundary check. No renderer or total-game percentage claim.
